h-sc-04.note: The card drops the Growth-plan restriction and broadens eligibility. (Model baseline said faithful.)
h-sc-04.source: Usage-based billing is available for customers on the Growth plan.
h-sc-04.card: Usage-based billing is available to customers.

cp-18.note: The card omits the material risk of conflicts between offline edits. (Model baseline said partly.)
cp-18.source: The beta adds offline editing, though changes made offline may conflict with edits from others.

to-26.note: The card omits the debugging trade-off associated with flaky tests. (Model baseline said partly.)
to-26.source: Running tests in parallel shortens the pipeline, though flaky tests become harder to debug.
to-26.card: Running tests in parallel shortens the pipeline.

ng-08.note: Rewritten card. The original card ("No jobs run on public holidays.") is distorted: it broadens the scope from this scheduler to all jobs (model baseline said distorted, rightly).
ng-08.source: The scheduler doesn't run jobs on public holidays.
ng-08.card: The scheduler runs no jobs on public holidays.

to-02.note: Rewritten card. The original card ("…but data loss is avoided") is distorted: it turns protection into a guarantee (model baseline said distorted, rightly).
to-02.source: Synchronous replication protects against data loss at the cost of higher write latency.
to-02.card: Synchronous replication has higher write latency but protects against data loss.

qt-19.note: Rubric v2: a requirement for N approvals means at least N approvals unless an exact count is stated. (Model baseline said faithful; draft said distorted.)
qt-19.source: At least two approvals are required before merging.
qt-19.card: Two approvals are required before merging.
